# Repository Instructions

Follow the architectural invariants, package boundaries, formatting standards, reference pins, and quality gates defined in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** and **[REFERENCE.md](../REFERENCE.md)**.

Key rules at a glance:

- **Pure-Dart SDK Boundary (`packages/markdown_engine/lib/`)**: Never import `package:flutter`, `dart:ui`, `dart:io`, `dart:html`, or `dart:js*`, keep `dependencies:` strictly limited to `meta: ^1.16.0`, run synchronously without filesystem or network access, and maintain Dart `^3.8.0` compatibility (no Dart 3.12+ private named-parameter shorthands `this._field`).
- **CommonMark & GFM Spec Parity + Security**: Target exact HTML compliance against vendored `CommonMark 0.31.2` (`652` examples) and `github/cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13` (`672` spec + `30` extension examples) under `MarkdownOptions.commonMark()` and `MarkdownOptions.gfm()`, while keeping default `const MarkdownOptions()` with all 23 extensions enabled and `MarkdownUrlPolicy.strict()`. Enforce `MarkdownBudgets` and linear-time HTML5 sanitization (`sanitizeHtml: true`).
- **Linear-Time HTML Block Renderer (`packages/markdown_engine_flutter/lib/src/html_block_renderer.dart`)**: Use single-pass linear tokenization (`_tokenizeHtml`), decode entities (`decodeHtmlEntities`) strictly after tokenization, validate URI attributes against `MarkdownUrlPolicy`, and enforce depth and element budgets (`maxHtmlBlockDepth: 32`, `maxHtmlTableRows: 500`, `maxHtmlTableColumns: 64`, `maxHtmlColspan: 16`, `maxHtmlListItems: 1000`, `maxHtmlBlocks: 1000`, `maxHtmlInlines: 4000`).
- **Flutter Sliver, Selection & Built-In Renderer Invariants (`packages/markdown_engine_flutter/lib/`)**: Keep `package:flutter/widgets.dart`-first layering (scoped `material.dart` `show` imports) targeting Flutter `>=3.47.0` and Dart `^3.13.0`. Preserve `SliverMarkdownDocument` lazy virtualization keyed by `node.blockId` (`addAutomaticKeepAlives: true`), `SelectionArea`/`SelectableRegion` full-document selection (`Cmd+A` exports `activeDocument.toPlainText()`), `SelectionContainer.disabled` around UI chrome, zero-reparse theme switching, hybrid two-sliver streaming tail canvas (`RenderMarkdownStreamingCanvas`), and dual-budget LRU caches + web-safe persistent Mermaid worker pool (`MarkdownBuiltInRenderers`).
- **Lockstep Package Versioning**: Keep `packages/markdown_engine/pubspec.yaml`, `packages/markdown_engine_flutter/pubspec.yaml`, top `## <version>` headings in both `CHANGELOG.md` files, and `packages/markdown_engine_flutter`'s `markdown_engine: ^<version>` constraint synchronized (`tool/check_versions.dart`), while internal `publish_to: none` workspace pubspecs keep `any`.
- **Verification Gates**: Ensure `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed packages tool studio`, `dart analyze --fatal-infos` (workspace root and `tool/compare`), all `dart test` and `flutter test` suites, `tool/check_versions.dart`, `tool/sync_reference.dart --verify`, `tool/verify_spec.dart --strict`, and `tool/benchmark_suite.dart --check-regressions` pass before completion.
- **Commit Policy**: Use Conventional Commits and omit automated tool credits, trailer attributions, or synthetic author tags from commit messages, pull request descriptions, and comments.
